biotools.summary: SMARTER Database is a tool for integrating SNP array datasets for sheep and goat breeds, focusing on standardizing genomic data and metadata to facilitate genetic diversity analyses. It harmonizes genotype data for thousands of sheep and goats, providing tools for efficient filtering and selection of samples.
